player_prompt.intro:
Karibu katika Ziwa lililofungwa!

Wewe unawakilishwa na 'P' kwenye gridi.
Miwani ya gridi:
  ' ' = Uso uliofungwa (salama kuendesha)
  'H' = Shimo (anguka na upoteze!)
  'G' = Lengo (fikia hili ili ushinde!)
  'P' = Nafasi yako ya sasa

Hatua zinazopatikana: juu, chini, kushoto, kulia (au w, a, s, d)
Andika hatua yako kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] au [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lengo: Abiri kutoka kwa mwanzo (juu-kushoto) hadi lengo (chini-kulia) bila kuingia kwenye mashimo yoyote!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muundo wa hatua si sahihi. Tumia [up], [down], [left], [right] au [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Ok ong'e gima itimo '{action}'. Ti gi malo, piny, koracham, korachwich kata w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Ne itemo ringo {action} to kata kamano ne igoyo kor ot!

outcome.win: Amor ahinya! In gi thuolo maber mar chopo e gik midwaro timo!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Ne ipodho e bur! Tuke orumo. Isechopo {pct}% mar wuoth nyaka kama idwaro chopoe.
outcome.turn_limit: Iseromo tong' mar ng'wech! Tuke orumo. Isechopo {pct}% mag wuoth madhi e kar tieko ringo.
